title: Movistar — E-commerce operations and checkout experience
summary: Work on catalog, checkout, payments, and shipping on a Magento 2 multistore platform for Telefónica retail. Client-specific details and final metrics are pending confirmation from the owner before publication.
role: Lead Engineer / Front End E-commerce (at NTT DATA / Stefanini)
context: Corporate engagement inside NTT DATA and Stefanini accounts focused on Magento 2 for Telefónica retail in Peru. The CV-reported scope covers catalog, checkout, payments, shipping, and multistore customizations, but the closed client-side details (logos, screenshots, and metrics) require owner validation before publishing them.
challenges: Keep visual and functional coherence across multiple stores (multistore) without duplicating implementations.
Customize checkout and catalog while staying compatible with third-party modules.
Normalize event tracking across critical flows (payments, shipping) for analytics.
approach: Magento 2 implementation in PHP, JavaScript, Knockout.js, RequireJS, and LESS, leaning on layout XML, UI Components, and native patterns.
Per-store modularization using Magento 2 multistore capabilities (scope, themes, and configuration per store view).
Integration with payment and shipping services through certified APIs and modules.
Version control, code review, and deployments following the team's agile practices.
outcomes: Catalog, checkout, payments, and shipping running with maintainable customizations inside the Magento 2 ecosystem.
Delivery under Scrum / Kanban with pull requests, code reviews, and technical documentation.
Final conversion, abandonment, and performance metrics pending validation before publishing.
stack: REST APIs for payments and shipping
